properties.name: coco.openapi.enabled
properties.description: Whether Coco OpenAPI infrastructure is enabled.

properties.name: coco.openapi.springdoc.enabled
properties.description: Whether Coco should adapt OpenAPI metadata into SpringDoc when SpringDoc is on the application classpath.

properties.name: coco.openapi.springdoc.response-schemas-enabled
properties.description: Whether Coco should publish bounded OpenAPI unified response and error response schemas into SpringDoc components.
